areas.title: Technology
areas.summary: Build apps, solve problems, and create useful digital tools.
areas.prompt: Do you enjoy solving problems, building things, or improving how technology works?

areas.title: Health
areas.summary: Help people stay healthy, recover, and live well.
areas.prompt: Are you curious about health, science, and helping people?

areas.title: Science
areas.summary: Ask questions, test ideas, and learn how things work.
areas.prompt: Do you enjoy asking why, testing ideas, and learning from what you find?

areas.title: Business
areas.summary: Turn ideas into useful products, services, and organisations.
areas.prompt: Do you enjoy planning, making decisions, or bringing an idea to life?

areas.title: Design and Media
areas.summary: Create clear, useful, and engaging experiences and stories.
areas.prompt: Do you enjoy understanding people, shaping ideas, and making things easier to use?

areas.title: Education and Society
areas.summary: Teach, support communities, and help solve public problems.
areas.prompt: Do you enjoy helping people learn, take part, or solve shared problems?

roles.title: Software Developer
roles.summary: Designs, builds, tests, and improves software used by people or organizations.
dailyWork: Break a problem into smaller parts
Write and review code
Test, debug, and discuss improvements with a team
roles.workSetting: Often computer-based and collaborative; the product and team can matter as much as the programming language.
roles.pathway: People enter through computing degrees, related diplomas, or strong project portfolios. The useful route depends on the role and employer.
tradeoffs: Do you enjoy long periods of focused problem-solving?
How do you feel about continually learning new tools?
roles.tryThis: Build a tiny webpage or automate one repetitive task, then note which part you enjoyed.

roles.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
roles.summary: Helps identify, investigate, and reduce risks to digital systems and information.
dailyWork: Review unusual activity and security alerts
Investigate how a weakness could be used
Document risks and help teams improve controls
roles.workSetting: Computer-based work that can include careful routine monitoring and urgent incident response.
roles.pathway: Computing foundations, networking, operating systems, ethical practice, and hands-on labs are common preparation areas.
tradeoffs: Can you stay careful during repetitive checks?
Would you be comfortable handling responsibility during an incident?
roles.tryThis: Complete a beginner cyber-safety lab and explain the risk and fix to someone else.
roles.salaryRange: AmbitionBox reports a typical ₹6.5–7.2 lakh per year for 1–5 years of experience in India, based on 12.6k salary reports (updated 2026).
roles.growthOutlook: Cybersecurity work exists across government and private sectors, but opportunities depend on current skills, certifications, location, and experience.

roles.title: Physician
roles.summary: Assesses health concerns, makes clinical decisions, and works with patients and care teams.
dailyWork: Listen to symptoms and medical history
Examine, investigate, and reason through possible causes
Discuss treatment, prevention, and follow-up
roles.workSetting: Clinical environments with direct human responsibility, teamwork, documentation, and sometimes irregular hours.
roles.pathway: This is a regulated profession with formal medical education, supervised training, and current licensing requirements that must be checked officially.
tradeoffs: Are you prepared for a long and demanding education route?
How might you respond to uncertainty and emotionally difficult situations?
roles.tryThis: Interview a healthcare professional about a normal day, including the parts that are difficult.

roles.title: Physiotherapist
roles.summary: Helps people improve movement, function, and recovery through assessment and guided activity.
dailyWork: Observe movement and understand a person's goals
Plan and demonstrate exercises
Track progress and adjust the rehabilitation plan
roles.workSetting: Hospitals, clinics, rehabilitation centres, sports settings, community services, or home visits.
roles.pathway: Formal physiotherapy education and applicable professional requirements are central; verify current eligibility with official institutions.
tradeoffs: Do you enjoy patient, repeated coaching?
Are you comfortable with active, people-facing work?
roles.tryThis: Learn how one common movement is assessed and ask a physiotherapist why the same exercise may not suit everyone.

roles.title: Biomedical Engineer
roles.summary: Applies engineering and design to medical devices, health systems, and human needs.
dailyWork: Understand a clinical or user problem
Design, test, or maintain a device or system
Work with engineers, clinicians, quality, and regulatory teams
roles.workSetting: Engineering teams, laboratories, hospitals, manufacturing, quality, or research environments.
roles.pathway: Engineering, mathematics, science, design, and health context commonly meet in this field; routes vary by specialization.
tradeoffs: Do you enjoy both technical detail and human context?
Would careful testing and documentation feel meaningful or frustrating?
roles.tryThis: Choose one medical device and map the user need, engineering problem, and safety questions behind it.

roles.title: Environmental Scientist
roles.summary: Studies environmental systems and evidence to understand problems and support decisions.
dailyWork: Collect or examine field and laboratory data
Analyze patterns and possible causes
Explain findings to communities, organizations, or decision-makers
roles.workSetting: A mix of field sites, laboratories, computers, reports, and conversations with different stakeholders.
roles.pathway: Environmental science, biology, chemistry, earth science, geography, statistics, or related study can lead toward different roles.
tradeoffs: Would you enjoy combining fieldwork with careful analysis?
Can you communicate evidence when people disagree about what to do?
roles.tryThis: Observe one local environmental issue and separate what you know, assume, and still need to measure.

roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.summary: Uses data, statistics, and computing to investigate questions and support decisions.
dailyWork: Clarify the question behind a data request
Clean, explore, and model data
Explain results, limits, and uncertainty
roles.workSetting: Mostly computer-based, often working across technical and non-technical teams.
roles.pathway: Statistics, mathematics, computing, domain knowledge, and evidence of practical projects are common foundations.
tradeoffs: Do you enjoy cleaning messy information before finding patterns?
Can you explain when a result is uncertain or misleading?
roles.tryThis: Use a small public dataset to answer one question and list two reasons your answer may be incomplete.

roles.title: Product Manager
roles.summary: Helps a team understand a user problem, choose priorities, and learn whether a product works.
dailyWork: Talk with users and teams about problems
Compare options and decide what to test next
Align design, technology, and business work
roles.workSetting: Highly collaborative work in product organizations; responsibilities vary widely between companies.
roles.pathway: There is no single regulated route. People enter from technology, design, business, research, operations, and domain experience.
tradeoffs: Can you make decisions with incomplete information?
Would coordinating without controlling every detail suit you?
roles.tryThis: Find one frustrating school experience, interview two users, and propose the smallest useful improvement.

roles.title: Chartered Accountant
roles.summary: Works with financial records, assurance, tax, controls, and business decisions within a regulated profession.
dailyWork: Examine financial information and supporting evidence
Apply accounting, audit, or tax rules
Explain findings and risks to clients or teams
roles.workSetting: Focused analytical work with deadlines, documentation, client conversations, and professional standards.
roles.pathway: The route is governed by ICAI and includes current eligibility, examinations, and practical training requirements that must be checked officially.
tradeoffs: Do you enjoy precision and checking evidence?
How would you handle concentrated study and deadline periods?
roles.tryThis: Review a simple budget and trace how one error could affect a later decision.

roles.title: UX Designer
roles.summary: Studies how people use a product or service and designs clearer, more usable experiences.
dailyWork: Observe or interview users
Map problems and create possible designs
Test prototypes and improve them with evidence
roles.workSetting: Collaborative product, service, research, or agency teams with a mix of conversation and focused design work.
roles.pathway: Design, psychology, research, technology, communication, and a portfolio of thoughtful work can all contribute.
tradeoffs: Can you revise an idea after user feedback?
Do you enjoy explaining why a design decision helps?
roles.tryThis: Watch someone use a confusing form, sketch a clearer version, and test it without explaining it.

roles.title: Journalist
roles.summary: Finds, verifies, explains, and communicates information that matters to an audience.
dailyWork: Research a question and identify reliable sources
Interview people and verify claims
Write, record, edit, and correct a story
roles.workSetting: Newsrooms, field reporting, digital media, audio, video, or independent work, often with deadlines.
roles.pathway: Strong reporting, writing, verification, media ethics, subject knowledge, and published work matter across varied study routes.
tradeoffs: Can you stay fair when you have a strong opinion?
How would you handle deadlines, criticism, and correcting mistakes?
roles.tryThis: Report one school issue using two independent sources and clearly separate fact from opinion.

roles.title: Teacher
roles.summary: Designs learning experiences, explains ideas, observes progress, and supports learners.
dailyWork: Plan how students can understand and practise an idea
Teach, question, listen, and adapt
Review work and coordinate with families or colleagues
roles.workSetting: Schools and other learning environments with sustained responsibility for groups and individual learners.
roles.pathway: Teacher education and eligibility requirements depend on level, subject, and system; official current rules should guide planning.
tradeoffs: Do you enjoy explaining the same idea in different ways?
Can you balance care, boundaries, planning, and administration?
roles.tryThis: Teach a ten-minute concept, ask the learner to explain it back, and revise your explanation.

roles.title: Policy Researcher
roles.summary: Investigates public problems and examines evidence, tradeoffs, and possible policy responses.
dailyWork: Define a public question and gather evidence
Compare who may benefit or be affected
Write clear analysis for decision-makers and communities
roles.workSetting: Research organizations, government, universities, civil society, or advisory teams, usually combining analysis and communication.
roles.pathway: Social science, economics, law, public policy, statistics, subject expertise, and research experience can lead toward different roles.
tradeoffs: Can you examine a problem without rushing to a simple answer?
Do you enjoy balancing evidence, values, and practical constraints?
roles.tryThis: Choose one local rule, identify the problem it addresses, and map who gains, who pays, and what evidence is missing.
